title: ArigConfig
description: Top-level arig config. Lives at `arig.yaml` by default.

dirs.description: Directories arig writes to. Defaults under `.arig/var/`.

services.description: Services to supervise, keyed by service name.

logs.description: Base directory for per-session log folders.

tcp.description: TCP host:port to connect to. Probe passes when connect() succeeds.

timeout.description: Total time to keep retrying before giving up. e.g. "30s", "1m 30s".

build.description:
Command that rebuilds this service; run by `arig build` and
`arig restart --build`. Runs on the host through the system shell, in
working_dir with env, whatever the runtime.

command.description:
Command line to execute. Required by the `process` runtime. On
`docker` it overrides the image's command, and may be omitted.

depends_on.description: Other service names that must be ready before this one starts.

env.description: Extra environment variables to set for the process.

image.description: Container image. Required by the `docker` runtime, ignored otherwise.

ports.description:
Ports to publish, as "host:container" or a bare port for both.
`docker` only.

ready.description: Optional readiness probe. Dependents wait until this passes.

runtime.description:
Which runtime runs this service. `process` runs it via the system
shell; `docker` runs it as a container.

shutdown.description:
Optional shutdown hook. When present, this command is run instead of
signalling the process directly. Useful for thin CLI wrappers that
delegate to a daemon (e.g. `docker compose up`).

timeout.description:
Maximum time a oneshot may run before it's killed and the wave fails,
and the same limit for this service's `build`. A long-running service's
own process is not bound by it. e.g. "5m", "30s". No default: opt-in.

working_dir.description: Working directory for the command. Relative to the config file's directory.

ServiceType.description: How arig should treat a service for shutdown and exit semantics.

oneOf.description: Long-running process; arig keeps it alive and stops it on shutdown.
Runs to completion once; arig waits for exit before dependents start.

ShutdownConfig.description: Shutdown hook configuration for a service.

command.description: Command to run to stop the service.

timeout.description:
How long to wait for the main process to exit after the command runs.
Falls back to signal/kill if the process is still alive. e.g. "30s", "2m".
